## Person and task
Who is this for, and what did they ask in ordinary language?
For a fix, link the issue it fixes (Fixes #123).

## Before and after
What changed in the resulting work or the effort needed to produce it?

## Reproduce and check
Public-safe inputs, exact versions, focused checks and output evidence.
For file tasks, link the case ID and separate first-attempt/revision results.

## Remaining friction
What setup, manual repair or uncertainty remains? What was not tested?

## Credit
Sources and licenses for copied code, examples, fonts or assets.

## AI use
Did an AI tool help, which one and how much? "None" is an answer.
